findings.quote: Losing the factor of one-half while integrating v dv = 4 dt, writing v = 4t + C instead of v²/2 = 4t + C, which gives a = 0.4 m/s².
findings.note: The named cause does not match the equation it then prints. Losing only the one-half gives v² = 4t + C, which leads to a = 0.63 m/s²; the printed wrong equation v = 4t + C drops the whole v²/2 and is what gives 0.4 m/s². The number is right, the label for the error is not.
findings.fix: Writing the left side of ∫v dv as v instead of v²/2, so that v = 4t + C, gives v = 10 m/s at t = 3 s and a = 0.4 m/s².
